offering_description.value: Designs, sources and markets branded consumer products for beauty, wellness, housewares and outdoor use. Sells mainly through mass retailers, specialty retailers and online channels, with products made by contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: hair care appliances; personal care devices; kitchen tools; insulated drinkware; backpacks and bags

customer_segment.value: B2B: mass merchants, specialty retailers, e-commerce marketplaces and distributors; B2C: individual consumers buying through retail and online channels

end_markets.value: consumer goods; beauty and personal care; housewares; outdoor recreation

revenue_model.value: product sales: consumer products sold to retailers, distributors and online shoppers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets products made by outside manufacturers, sold to retailers and consumers; retailer: sells directly to consumers through its own websites and some salon or store locations

geography_served.value: global: sells in North America, Europe, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: separate consumer lines including beauty and wellness appliances, housewares, and outdoor and travel products

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: mass merchants, drugstores and specialty retailers; online: company websites and major e-commerce marketplaces; distributors / dealers: distributors serving international and smaller retail accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety and electrical standards for appliances and consumer goods, plus some regulated over-the-counter health products

notes: Business mix and brand portfolio change over time, so product lines described may not be fully current.
divestiture_lines: P2.9: Divested Mass Market Personal Care Business
